reviews.review:
I created account for this game over 3 years ago, played maybe 2 hours and deleted it.

I came back after all that time and I have to say that I am amazed how this game have developed. There is still room for improvement but I would definitely recommend it even if just to have a go. Best F2P of recent years.

EDIT: Congrats for the developers, I am now officially addicted.

This is an amazing game, not only is it free to play, its not a pay to win type of game and everything is obtainable in some way, and yes, you can pay for things like skins to customize your warframe and your weapons to make them look amazing and you can buy platinum to speed things up and buy things like deluxe skins, which i will say there is tons of different ways to make it your own, and you can also use platinum to just buy warframes instead of farming for them or buying prime parts from other players, the only downside in my opinion would be the time based building process, it can be a bit long at times, but with the amount of content this game currently has with the optional quests and star chart to complete, there is plenty of stuff to do while you wait, and if you're wondering about the player base, well the players are really nice, i have played warframe for almost 2 years now and i have had very few problems with player, yes you may get the occasional bad apple once in a while, but for the most part the players are very friendly, the game gets updated quite a bit in comparison to some games and the devs are very nice and actually listen to the players feedback and make changes accordingly, the game overall is just a very nice game, so far the best game i have played on steam and ill continue playing this game, and if its not obvious, i highly recommend this game
